_source.title: 文件系统文件路径
_source.properties.relativePath: 相对路径，不包含前面的传入路径和文件名（当没有传入路径时，不存在相对路径），且前后均无斜杠
_source.properties.fullPath: 完整路径，包含文件名的绝对路径

title: File system file path
properties.fileName: File name (no slashes at the beginning or end)
properties.relativePath: Relative path, not including the passed-in path and file name (when no path is passed in, there is no relative path), with no slashes at the beginning or end
properties.fullPath: Full path, an absolute path including the file name
